verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships official CLIs. `create-playcanvas` scaffolds Vite/TypeScript projects from 12 starters, and those new projects include PlayCanvas Skills for AI coding agents. `@playcanvas/splat-transform` is a documented CLI for Gaussian splat processing. Neither is a general-purpose CLI for managing or driving Editor projects; agent-driven Editor control goes through the MCP server and Editor API instead. Missing for 10: a general project/Editor/publish CLI, documentation of the CLI's commands and non-interactive (agent-friendly) flags, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI workflows.
